text:
nina: Quick decision needed for pilot: do we go with Burst Credits (prepaid packs) or Temporary SLA lanes (timeboxed reservation)? Need single direction for the deck.

cal: Field says prepaid packs. Procurement prefers discrete SKUs they can buy and consume.

marta: Engineering: reservations are straightforward conceptually but expensive. Softcaps + credit packs are far cheaper to run.

oliver: PM: hybrid idea tiny reserved baseline + burst packs for short spikes. Keeps compliance customers happy without overcommitting infra.

legal-bot: Reminder: cannot market bursts as guaranteed. Must include best-effort and preemption language in T&Cs.

pricing-bot: Recommendation: sell credits as "concurrency-minutes" packs. Surge top-ups at 3x base unit. Logged PR-998.

nina: GTM asks: buyer kit with 3 worked examples, console UX for "apply burst" and live balance, and explicit throttle FAQ.

cal: Sales: need wording that maps concurrency-minutes to requests for non-technical buyers. Also one-click buy in-console.

marta: Engineering gating: entitlement API + sim-throttle mode + billing hook. Can deliver prototype in 2 sprints.

oliver: Launch gates: perf benchmark p95 <200ms under softcap, two pilot customers, and completed billing QA.

nina: Action items: pricing-bot propose pack sizes and price points (due Tue), legal-bot submit contract snippet (due Tue), marta build entitlement API & sim mode (due next sprint), oliver prepare buyer kit (due Thu). Decide pilot model by EOD Fri.

pricing-bot: Noted. I'll add sample pack tiers and call out conversion examples for API-calls equivalence."
